What is mocked

  • All creations, creators, biomes and descriptions are invented samples; grey boxes stand for the 3D preview.
  • "Add to my world" only changes this page's state. Nothing is saved or published.
  • Private (paid) creation is shown as a choice only; no pricing, billing or privacy behaviour exists.
  • Biome filter is one choice at a time. Faceted multi-select is left for a later round, on purpose.
  • Quality tiers (Study, Indie, Pro) and Capture phases appear only as a source line on a creation. They are Capture's tiers, not this study's low, high, game-ready stages.

Questions for Evan

1. Entry. The browser opens from a door in the world (shown). Alternative: a card or a menu item. Which feels right?
2. Shared by default, said before accepting. The add step states plainly that the creation joins your world and the shared world, with private as a paid option. Is a checkbox-style choice right, or should the sentence alone do it?
3. "Add" meaning. Here, adding someone else's creation places a copy in your world and keeps credit to its creator. Should the creator's original stay linked, so updates can flow?
4. Raw capture media. Shown as never part of a creation's page, only the accepted derived creation. Should the browser ever show the inspiration (a photo, say) next to a creation, if the creator allows it?
5. Owner view. Private creations appear only in "My creations" with a lock, never in discovery. Enough, or do you want a visible "private" count to others?
